blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Following the recent deaths of two basketball players who reportedly suffered heart-related emergencies during and after games, the Mandaue City Council has passed a resolution urging city sports officials to ensure that standby medical teams are present at all public and private sporting events in the city. The resolution, authored by Councilor Raul Kevin Flores Cabahug, seeks to ensure immediate medical assistance for athletes, players, coaches, officials, spectators, and other participants in the event of medical emergencies during sporting activities. The measure comes following the deaths of former professional basketball player Peter June Simon on November 20, […]...
